It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- deep-research: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. - When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

# AGENTS.md — 本仓库短地图

> 保持简短。细节在 Skill `references/` 与 `skill-pack/`，不要把百科写进这里。

## 路由

| 用户意图 | 动作 |
|----------|------|
| 开发功能 / 从 0 搭 / 模糊需求 / 「按 SOP」 | **必须** `/ai-dev-sop`（`skills/ai-dev-sop/`） |
| 纯问答、解释代码、与实现无关 | 普通对话即可 |
| 明确单行热修且用户拒绝完整 SOP | 可直改；**仍须** diff 自检，禁止碰 G3 |

开发类任务：**禁止跳过 L1 需求澄清**直接写业务代码（除非用户书面要求热修且范围单文件）。

## Never

- 无用户确认的 Spec 就开始写业务功能
- 输出门禁哨兵句之前继续写码 / push
- 自主生产部署、删数、提交密钥
- 自主改资金结算、外部系统凭据、法定/合规字段、生产 PII 用途
- 把「可能、大概、优化一下」写进验收标准
- 全自动合 main

## Always

- 节点交付物进仓（见 `docs/节点交付物.md`）；对话批准不算完成
- 制品：SPEC / MVP / ARCH / PLAN / ACCEPTANCE
- G2 操作先预览再等人批；G3 升级授权审批人
- 范围变更 → 打回 L1；切片/架构变更 → 打回 PHASE 2/3
- 进入阶段时加载对应 `skill-pack/0x-*/SKILL.md`
- Spec → MVP → **架构** → Plan → …；热修可跳前几道，不可跳 Diff

## 关键路径

- Skill：`skills/ai-dev-sop/SKILL.md`
- 子技能：`skill-pack/01`…`06`（含 mvp-cut、arch-design）
- 节点交付物总表：`docs/节点交付物.md`
- 甲方收集：`templates/INTENT-raw.md`
- 产品整理 Intent：`templates/INTENT.md`（再 `/ai-dev-sop`）
- 模板：`SPEC` / `ACCEPTANCE` / `ARCHITECTURE` / 合规表
- DoR 脚本：`skills/ai-dev-sop/scripts/check-dor.sh`
- 人读总览：`docs/00-总览与流程图.md`

## 安装与试跑

```bash
./install.sh                 # 默认：用户级多客户端 + 本仓项目链
./install.sh --no-project    # 仅用户级（个人跨仓推荐）
./install.sh --tool grok     # 只装某一客户端目录
./install.sh --check
./install.sh --into /path/to/product-repo
```

读包内文件用 **SOP_ROOT**（`skills/ai-dev-sop` 目录再上两级）；写 Spec 到工作区 `docs/specs/`。

试跑：`docs/试跑剧本.md` → 记录 `docs/试跑记录.md` → 勾选 `docs/试点投产检查单.md`

## DoR 机械检查

```bash
./skills/ai-dev-sop/scripts/check-dor.sh <SPEC.md> [ACCEPTANCE.md]
```

1	# Cross-Session Memory
2	
3	Memory lets Grok recall facts, decisions, and patterns from earlier sessions. Grok indexes the information you save and searches it automatically, so a new session can reuse relevant context.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## What Is Memory?
8	
9	Without memory, each Grok session starts fresh: the model knows nothing about previous sessions. When you enable memory, Grok can:
10	
11	- Recall project conventions you explained before.
12	- Reuse debugging steps that worked.
13	- Carry architectural decisions forward across sessions.
14	- Avoid re-asking questions it already has answers to.
15	
16	Memory is experimental and disabled by default.
17	
18	---
19	
20	## Enabling Memory
21	
22	### Per-Session Flag
23	
24	```bash
25	grok --experimental-memory
26	```
27	
28	### Environment Variable
29	
30	```bash
31	export GROK_MEMORY=1
32	grok
33	```
34	
35	### Config File (Persistent)
36	
37	```toml
38	# ~/.grok/config.toml
39	[memory]
40	enabled = true
41	```
42	
43	### Force-Disable
44	
45	To disable memory even when other settings enable it:
46	
47	```bash
48	grok --no-memory
49	```
50	
51	Or:
52	
53	```bash
54	export GROK_MEMORY=0
55	```
56	
57	The `--no-memory` flag has absolute highest priority and always disables memory.
58	
59	### Mid-Session Toggle
60	
61	Toggle memory on or off during a session without restarting:
62	
63	```
64	/memory on
65	/memory off
66	```
67	
68	The toggle is session-scoped -- it does not persist to `config.toml`. Toggling off removes access to memory tools but keeps existing files on disk. Toggling on re-initializes memory storage and registers the memory tools.
69	
70	You can also toggle from inside the `/memory` modal by pressing `t`.
71	
72	### Priority Order
73	
74	1. `--no-memory` CLI flag (always disables)
75	2. `--experimental-memory` CLI flag (enables)
76	3. `GROK_MEMORY` env var: `1`/`true` enables, `0`/`false` disables
77	4. `[memory]` section in config.toml
78	5. Default: disabled
79	
80	---
81	
82	## How Memory Is Stored
83	
84	Memory is stored as Markdown files under `~/.grok/memory/`:
85	
86	| Location | Scope | Description |
87	|----------|-------|-------------|
88	| `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md` | Global | Facts that apply across all your projects |
89	| `~/.grok/memory/<project-slug>-<hash8>/MEMORY.md` | Workspace | Project-specific conventions and context |
90	| `~/.grok/memory/<project-slug>-<hash8>/sessions/` | Sessions | Per-session summaries and logs |
91	
92	Grok suffixes each workspace directory with a short hash of the repository's identity. The identity is the `origin` remote in `org/repo` form when the directory is a Git repository with an `origin` remote, or the directory path otherwise. Because clones and worktrees of the same repository share an `origin` remote, they also share one memory directory.
93	
94	An SQLite index supports hybrid search across all memory files:
95	- **FTS5** provides full-text search for keyword matching.
96	- **vec0** provides vector search for semantic similarity. Vector search is optional and requires an embedding.
97	
98	---
99	
100	## Automatic Saves
101	
102	When a session ends, Grok saves a structured metadata summary to that session's daily log. The summary contains:
103	
104	- Message counts (user, assistant, and tool results).
105	- Topics: the first few substantive user prompts from the session, up to five.
106	- The session date and time (UTC).
107	
108	Grok builds the summary from conversation metadata without an LLM call, without added latency. Grok skips the save for trivial sessions -- those with fewer than three substantive prompts, or fewer than 50 bytes of user text.
109	
110	The summary does not record tool usage, file paths, or shell commands. The session ID forms part of the log filename. To turn automatic saves off, set `session.save_on_end = false`. For richer capture of decisions, patterns, and reasoning, use `/flush`.
111	
112	---
113	
114	## Saving Rich Knowledge with /flush
115	
116	For richer capture -- decisions, patterns, debugging workflows, API discoveries -- use `/flush` in the TUI:
117	
118	```
119	/flush
120	```
121	
122	This triggers an LLM-generated summary of the current session's most important content and writes it to a dated session log. The summary is indexed and searchable in future sessions.
123	
124	Use `/flush` when you want to preserve important context:
125	- Before compaction (which discards old conversation turns)
126	- At the end of a productive debugging session
127	- After discovering important patterns or conventions
128	
129	---
130	
131	## Working with Memory
132	
133	### Remember
134	
135	Ask Grok to remember something, and it appends the note to a `MEMORY.md` file -- the workspace file for project-specific items, or the global `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md` for cross-project preferences:
136	
137	```
138	> remember to always open PR links after pushing
139	```
140	
141	Grok records entries as durable statements under organized headings, such as `## Preferences`, `## Project Context`, or `## Debugging`. The file watcher reindexes the change on the next memory search, so the new entry is searchable within the current session.
142	
143	You can also save a note directly with the `/remember` command:
144	
145	```
146	/remember always open PR links after pushing
147	```
148	
149	Run `/remember` with no text to enter remember mode, where the next line you type becomes the note. Either way, Grok opens a review panel showing the note (with an optional rewritten version you can toggle with `Tab`); the note is written only after you confirm. On save, Grok shows `Memory saved to ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`.
150	
151	### Forget
152	
153	Ask Grok to forget something, and it finds and removes the matching entry:
154	
155	```
156	> forget the snake_case convention
157	```
158	
159	Forget is best-effort: the model searches memory and removes entries that match. For guaranteed removal, edit the files under `~/.grok/memory/` directly and delete the entry yourself. To locate a file, open the `/memory` browser and press `y` to copy its path.
160	
161	### Recall
162	
163	Ask what Grok remembers:
164	
165	```
166	> what do you remember?
167	```
168	
169	Grok searches across all memory files and summarizes what it knows, grouped by source: global preferences, project-specific knowledge, and session history. Use `/memory` to browse the raw files.
170	
171	### Direct Editing
172	
173	You can edit memory files directly under `~/.grok/memory/`. The file watcher reindexes your changes on the next memory search. Use `/flush` to save the current session now, and `/dream` to consolidate session logs into organized topics.
174	
175	---
176	
177	## Browsing Memory with /memory
178	
179	The `/memory` command opens a modal showing all memory files:
180	
181	```
182	/memory
183	```
184	
185	Files are grouped by scope:
186	- **Global** -- cross-project memory (`MEMORY.md`).
187	- **Workspace** -- project-specific memory (`MEMORY.md`).
188	- **Sessions** -- per-session summaries, in reverse chronological order.
189	
190	The modal uses a split-pane layout: the file list on the left, a read-only content preview on the right. The preview updates as you move through the list.
191	
192	### Keyboard Shortcuts
193	
194	| Key | Action |
195	|-----|--------|
196	| `↑`/`↓` or `j`/`k` | Move through the file list |
197	| `PgUp`/`PgDn` | Jump 10 entries |
198	| `/` | Filter the file list |
199	| `y` | Copy the selected file's path to the clipboard |
200	| `x` | Delete the selected session file (press `x` again to confirm) |
201	| `t` | Toggle memory on or off |
202	| `Ctrl+F` | Toggle fullscreen |
203	| `Esc` | Close the modal, or exit filter mode |
204	
205	The preview pane is read-only. Scroll it with the mouse wheel or by dragging its scrollbar. You can delete only session files, not the global or workspace `MEMORY.md`.
206	
207	When the memory modal's content area is under 80 columns, the modal hides the preview pane and shows the file list only.
208	
209	You can also open `/memory` from the command palette.
210	
211	---
212	
213	## Memory Notifications
214	
215	When you save a note with `/remember`, Grok confirms in the scrollback:
216	
217	```
218	Memory saved to ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md
219	```
220	
221	Background saves — flush, dream, and session-end — run silently and do not post a scrollback message. Use `/memory` at any time to browse what Grok has stored.
222	
223	---
224	
225	## Dream Consolidation with /dream
226	
227	The `/dream` command consolidates scattered memory fragments into organized topics:
228	
229	```
230	/dream
231	```
232	
233	Dream reorganizes individual session logs and memory entries into a coherent, deduplicated knowledge base, which reduces noise and improves search quality over time. `/dream` requires memory to be enabled.
234	
235	### Auto-Dream
236	
237	Dream also runs automatically. By default, Grok checks the consolidation gates when a session ends and runs Dream once enough time has passed and enough sessions have accumulated:
238	
239	```toml
240	[memory.dream]
241	enabled = true     # Run automatic consolidation (default: true)
242	min_hours = 4      # Minimum hours between consolidations
243	min_sessions = 3   # Minimum sessions since the last consolidation
244	# check_interval_secs is unset by default, so Dream runs only at session end.
245	# Set it to a positive number of seconds to also check on a periodic interval.
246	```
247	
248	---
249	
250	## How Memory Affects Prompts
251	
252	### First-Turn Injection
253	
254	On the first turn of each session, Grok automatically searches memory for content relevant to the current project and injects it as context. This means Grok starts with knowledge from previous sessions without a reminder.
255	
256	First-turn injection can be configured:
257	
258	```toml
259	[memory.initial_injection]
260	enabled = true     # Enable or disable first-turn injection
261	min_score = 0.0    # Optional score threshold; unset by default, which applies no filtering
262	```
263	
264	### After Compaction
265	
266	Memory is also searched after auto-compaction to recover relevant context that may have been discarded.
267	
268	---
269	
270	## Memory Search
271	
272	Grok searches memory automatically, but you can also trigger searches manually in the chat:
273	
274	```
275	Search memory for "auth middleware patterns"
276	Read my workspace MEMORY.md
277	```
278	
279	The model has access to two memory tools:
280	- `memory_search` -- Hybrid search across all memory (vector + full-text)
281	- `memory_get` -- Read a specific memory file by path
282	
283	### Hybrid Scoring
284	
285	Memory search uses a weighted combination of:
286	- **Vector similarity** (semantic) -- weight: 0.7
287	- **BM25 text similarity** (keyword) -- weight: 0.3
288	
289	Results are filtered by a minimum score threshold (default: 0.35).
290	
291	### Source Weights
292	
293	Each memory source has a weight multiplier applied to its score. All sources default to `1.0`, and you can adjust any of them under `[memory.search.source_weights]`:
294	
295	| Source | Weight | Description |
296	|--------|--------|-------------|
297	| `workspace` | 1.0 | Project-specific memory |
298	| `session` | 1.0 | Session logs |
299	| `global` | 1.0 | Cross-project memory |
300	
301	### Temporal Decay
302	
303	Session memories decay over time so recent sessions are prioritized:
304	
305	```toml
306	[memory.search.temporal_decay]
307	enabled = true           # Enable time-based decay
308	half_life_days = 7.0     # Score halves after this many days
309	```
310	
311	Only session chunks decay. Global and workspace memories are exempt since they contain curated long-term knowledge.
312	
313	### MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance)
314	
315	MMR re-ranking penalizes redundant results to improve diversity:
316	
317	```toml
318	[memory.search.mmr]
319	enabled = false          # Opt-in diversity re-ranking
320	lambda = 0.7             # 0.0 = max diversity, 1.0 = pure relevance
321	```
322	
323	---
324	
325	## CLI Commands
326	
327	The `grok memory` command manages memory from the shell. It has one subcommand, `clear`:
328	
329	```bash
330	# Clear workspace memory (MEMORY.md, sessions/, and index.sqlite). This is the default scope.
331	grok memory clear
332	
333	# The same scope, stated explicitly
334	grok memory clear --workspace
335	
336	# Clear the global MEMORY.md
337	grok memory clear --global
338	
339	# Clear both workspace and global memory
340	grok memory clear --all
341	
342	# Skip the confirmation prompt (-y is the short form)
343	grok memory clear --yes
344	```
345	
346	To edit memory from the shell, open the files in your editor directly -- for example, `$EDITOR ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`.
347	
348	---
349	
350	## Configuration Reference
351	
352	### Core Settings (`[memory]`)
353	
354	| Key | Default | Description |
355	|-----|---------|-------------|
356	| `enabled` | `false` | Enable memory |
357	| `session.save_on_end` | `true` | Write metadata summary on session end |
358	| `watcher.enabled` | `true` | Watch `~/.grok/memory/` for external edits and reindex |
359	
360	### Index Settings (`[memory.index]`)
361	
362	| Key | Default | Description |
363	|-----|---------|-------------|
364	| `max_chunk_chars` | `1600` | Maximum chunk size in characters |
365	| `chunk_overlap_chars` | `320` | Character overlap between chunks |
366	
367	### Embedding Settings (`[memory.embedding]`)
368	
369	| Key | Default | Description |
370	|-----|---------|-------------|
371	| `provider` | `"api"` | Embedding provider (currently `"api"`) |
372	| `model` | *(provider default)* | Embedding model name |
373	| `dimensions` | `1024` | Embedding vector dimensions |
374	
375	### Search Settings (`[memory.search]`)
376	
377	| Key | Default | Description |
378	|-----|---------|-------------|
379	| `max_results` | `6` | Maximum search results |
380	| `min_score` | `0.35` | Minimum relevance score |
381	| `vector_weight` | `0.7` | Weight for vector similarity |
382	| `text_weight` | `0.3` | Weight for BM25 text similarity |
383	
384	### Initial Injection Settings (`[memory.initial_injection]`)
385	
386	| Key | Default | Description |
387	|-----|---------|-------------|
388	| `enabled` | `true` | Enable first-turn memory injection |
389	| `min_score` | unset | Score threshold for first-turn results. When unset, Grok applies no threshold, which is equivalent to `0.0`. |
390	
391	### Dream Settings (`[memory.dream]`)
392	
393	| Key | Default | Description |
394	|-----|---------|-------------|
395	| `enabled` | `true` | Enable automatic Dream consolidation |
396	| `min_hours` | `4` | Minimum hours between consolidations |
397	| `min_sessions` | `3` | Minimum sessions since the last consolidation |
398	| `stale_lock_secs` | `3600` | Seconds before a stale consolidation lock is reclaimed |
399	| `check_interval_secs` | unset | Periodic check interval in seconds. When unset, Dream runs only at session end. |
400	
401	### Flush Settings (`[compaction.memory_flush]`)
402	
403	You configure flush under `[compaction]`, not `[memory]`, because it is a compaction behavior.
404	
405	| Key | Default | Description |
406	|-----|---------|-------------|
407	| `enabled` | `true` | Enable the pre-compaction memory flush |
408	| `soft_threshold_tokens` | `4000` | Token headroom before the compact threshold that triggers a flush |
409	| `max_flush_write_chars` | `8000` | Maximum characters the flush may write to memory |
410	| `flush_model` | unset | Model for the flush turn. When unset, Grok uses the session's primary model. |
411	| `idle_timeout_secs` | unset | Idle seconds before a background flush. When unset, flush runs only before compaction. |
412	| `semantic_dedup_threshold` | unset | Cosine-similarity threshold for de-duplicating flushed content. When unset, defaults to `0.92`. |
413	
414	### Pruning Settings (`[compaction.pruning]`)
415	
416	You configure pruning under `[compaction]`, not `[memory]`, because it is a compaction behavior.
417	
418	| Key | Default | Description |
419	|-----|---------|-------------|
420	| `enabled` | `true` | Enable tool-result pruning |
421	| `keep_last_n_turns` | `3` | Number of recent turns whose tool results are never pruned |
422	| `soft_trim_threshold` | `4000` | Character threshold above which old tool results are soft-trimmed |

425	| `hard_clear_age_turns` | `10` | Turn age after which tool results are replaced with a placeholder |

429	## Memory Staleness
430	
431	When a session memory is old, Grok attaches a staleness note to it in search results. Older results get a stronger reminder to verify the current state before you rely on them. These notes help you spot stored facts that might no longer be accurate. Global and workspace memories never receive staleness notes, because they hold curated long-term knowledge.
432	
433	---
434	
435	## File Watcher
436	
437	By default, Grok watches `~/.grok/memory/` for external file changes. If you edit memory files directly (e.g., in your editor), the changes are picked up automatically on the next memory search:
438	
439	- Created or modified files are reindexed.
440	- Deleted files have their stale chunks removed from the index.
441	
442	```toml
443	[memory.watcher]
444	enabled = true    # default
445	```
446	
447	---
448	
449	## Troubleshooting
450	
451	### Memory Not Working
452	
453	1. Verify memory is enabled: check `grok inspect` output.
454	2. Check the flag: `grok --experimental-memory` or `GROK_MEMORY=1`.
455	3. Check for `--no-memory` or `GROK_MEMORY=0` overriding your config.
456	
457	### Memory Not Appearing in Sessions
458	
459	Memory is injected on the first turn. If you started a session before enabling memory, start a new session with `/new`.
460	
461	### Viewing Memory Files
462	
463	Use `/memory` in the TUI to browse all memory files with a preview. You can also access them directly:
464	
465	```bash
466	ls ~/.grok/memory/
467	cat ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md
468	$EDITOR ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md
469	```
470	
471	### Debug Logging
472	
473	```bash
474	RUST_LOG=debug GROK_LOG_FILE=/tmp/grok.log grok
475	grep "memory" /tmp/grok.log
476	```

# Cross-Session Memory

Memory lets Grok recall facts, decisions, and patterns from earlier sessions. Grok indexes the information you save and searches it automatically, so a new session can reuse relevant context.

---

## What Is Memory?

Without memory, each Grok session starts fresh: the model knows nothing about previous sessions. When you enable memory, Grok can:

- Recall project conventions you explained before.
- Reuse debugging steps that worked.
- Carry architectural decisions forward across sessions.
- Avoid re-asking questions it already has answers to.

Memory is experimental and disabled by default.

---

## Enabling Memory

### Per-Session Flag

```bash
grok --experimental-memory
```

### Environment Variable

```bash
export GROK_MEMORY=1
grok
```

### Config File (Persistent)

```toml
# ~/.grok/config.toml
[memory]
enabled = true
```

### Force-Disable

To disable memory even when other settings enable it:

```bash
grok --no-memory
```

Or:

```bash
export GROK_MEMORY=0
```

The `--no-memory` flag has absolute highest priority and always disables memory.

### Mid-Session Toggle

Toggle memory on or off during a session without restarting:

```
/memory on
/memory off
```

The toggle is session-scoped -- it does not persist to `config.toml`. Toggling off removes access to memory tools but keeps existing files on disk. Toggling on re-initializes memory storage and registers the memory tools.

You can also toggle from inside the `/memory` modal by pressing `t`.

### Priority Order

1. `--no-memory` CLI flag (always disables)
2. `--experimental-memory` CLI flag (enables)
3. `GROK_MEMORY` env var: `1`/`true` enables, `0`/`false` disables
4. `[memory]` section in config.toml
5. Default: disabled

---

## How Memory Is Stored

Memory is stored as Markdown files under `~/.grok/memory/`:

| Location | Scope | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md` | Global | Facts that apply across all your projects |
| `~/.grok/memory/<project-slug>-<hash8>/MEMORY.md` | Workspace | Project-specific conventions and context |
| `~/.grok/memory/<project-slug>-<hash8>/sessions/` | Sessions | Per-session summaries and logs |

Grok suffixes each workspace directory with a short hash of the repository's identity. The identity is the `origin` remote in `org/repo` form when the directory is a Git repository with an `origin` remote, or the directory path otherwise. Because clones and worktrees of the same repository share an `origin` remote, they also share one memory directory.

An SQLite index supports hybrid search across all memory files:
- **FTS5** provides full-text search for keyword matching.
- **vec0** provides vector search for semantic similarity. Vector search is optional and requires an embedding.

---

## Automatic Saves

When a session ends, Grok saves a structured metadata summary to that session's daily log. The summary contains:

- Message counts (user, assistant, and tool results).
- Topics: the first few substantive user prompts from the session, up to five.
- The session date and time (UTC).

Grok builds the summary from conversation metadata without an LLM call, without added latency. Grok skips the save for trivial sessions -- those with fewer than three substantive prompts, or fewer than 50 bytes of user text.

The summary does not record tool usage, file paths, or shell commands. The session ID forms part of the log filename. To turn automatic saves off, set `session.save_on_end = false`. For richer capture of decisions, patterns, and reasoning, use `/flush`.

---

## Saving Rich Knowledge with /flush

For richer capture -- decisions, patterns, debugging workflows, API discoveries -- use `/flush` in the TUI:

```
/flush
```

This triggers an LLM-generated summary of the current session's most important content and writes it to a dated session log. The summary is indexed and searchable in future sessions.

Use `/flush` when you want to preserve important context:
- Before compaction (which discards old conversation turns)
- At the end of a productive debugging session
- After discovering important patterns or conventions

---

## Working with Memory

### Remember

Ask Grok to remember something, and it appends the note to a `MEMORY.md` file -- the workspace file for project-specific items, or the global `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md` for cross-project preferences:

```
> remember to always open PR links after pushing
```

Grok records entries as durable statements under organized headings, such as `## Preferences`, `## Project Context`, or `## Debugging`. The file watcher reindexes the change on the next memory search, so the new entry is searchable within the current session.

You can also save a note directly with the `/remember` command:

```
/remember always open PR links after pushing
```

Run `/remember` with no text to enter remember mode, where the next line you type becomes the note. Either way, Grok opens a review panel showing the note (with an optional rewritten version you can toggle with `Tab`); the note is written only after you confirm. On save, Grok shows `Memory saved to ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`.

### Forget

Ask Grok to forget something, and it finds and removes the matching entry:

```
> forget the snake_case convention
```

Forget is best-effort: the model searches memory and removes entries that match. For guaranteed removal, edit the files under `~/.grok/memory/` directly and delete the entry yourself. To locate a file, open the `/memory` browser and press `y` to copy its path.

### Recall

Ask what Grok remembers:

```
> what do you remember?
```

Grok searches across all memory files and summarizes what it knows, grouped by source: global preferences, project-specific knowledge, and session history. Use `/memory` to browse the raw files.

### Direct Editing

You can edit memory files directly under `~/.grok/memory/`. The file watcher reindexes your changes on the next memory search. Use `/flush` to save the current session now, and `/dream` to consolidate session logs into organized topics.

---

## File Watcher

By default, Grok watches `~/.grok/memory/` for external file changes. If you edit memory files directly (e.g., in your editor), the changes are picked up automatically on the next memory search:

- Created or modified files are reindexed.
- Deleted files have their stale chunks removed from the index.

```toml
[memory.watcher]
enabled = true    # default
```

---

## Troubleshooting

### Memory Not Working

1. Verify memory is enabled: check `grok inspect` output.
2. Check the flag: `grok --experimental-memory` or `GROK_MEMORY=1`.
3. Check for `--no-memory` or `GROK_MEMORY=0` overriding your config.

### Memory Not Appearing in Sessions

Memory is injected on the first turn. If you started a session before enabling memory, start a new session with `/new`.

### Viewing Memory Files

Use `/memory` in the TUI to browse all memory files with a preview. You can also access them directly:

```bash
ls ~/.grok/memory/
cat ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md
$EDITOR ~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md
```

### Debug Logging

```bash
RUST_LOG=debug GROK_LOG_FILE=/tmp/grok.log grok
grep "memory" /tmp/grok.log
```

```

  chat_history.jsonl      # raw chat messages sent to the model
  plan.json               # TODO/task list state

```

### New Session

The TUI creates a new session each time you launch. To explicitly start fresh mid-session:

```
/new
```

### Exit

```
/quit
```

### Delete the current session

```

---

### From the TUI

Use the `/resume` command to browse and resume previous sessions:

```

```

This opens a session picker that lists recent sessions for the current workspace. Select a session to resume it. The command takes no arguments.

Typing in the picker filters the list by title and also searches your conversation content as you type; content matches appear under an "Extended search results" heading. Press `Ctrl+/` to search immediately without the brief pause.

```bash

```

### From the Welcome Screen

---

### Fork

```

```

```

```

```

```

1. Shows a list of rewind points (one per user prompt)
2. Lets you select which point to rewind to
3. Restores all files to their state at that point
4. Truncates the conversation history to that point

---

## The /compact Command

```

### Auto-Compact

---

```

```

- Session title (when set)
- Shell version
- Auth method (OAuth vs API key) and where to manage account and credits (https://grok.com/?_s=billing for OAuth, console.x.ai for API key; API-key sessions also suggest `grok login` for SuperGrok)
- Session ID
- Working directory
- Model (with a model hash for coding models)
- API backend and sandbox profile (when set)
- Context window usage (used and total tokens, with the percentage used)

---

## Headless Session Management

In headless mode, you manage sessions through command-line flags:

```bash
# New session each time (default)
grok -p "Hello"

# Resume an existing session by ID or title (errors if it does not exist)
grok -p "Continue where we left off" -r <session-id-or-title>

# Continue the most recent session in the current directory
grok -p "What were we doing?" -c
```

To read the session ID back, request JSON output:

```bash
grok -p "Hello" --output-format json | jq -r '.sessionId'
```

---

## Agent stdio Session Management

When building with ACP, sessions are managed via protocol methods:

```typescript
// Create new session
const { sessionId } = await connection.request("session/new", {
  cwd: "/path/to/project",
  mcpServers: [],
});

// Load existing session
await connection.request("session/load", {
  sessionId: "existing-session-id",
  cwd: "/path/to/project",
  mcpServers: [],
});
```

---

## The grok sessions Subcommand

List or search sessions from the command line. `grok sessions` requires a subcommand:

```bash
# List recent sessions for the current directory
grok sessions list

# Limit the number of results (default 20)

# Search sessions by keyword (matches titles and prompts)

```

When working with subagents or session forks, Grok can create isolated git worktrees per session. Each worktree gets its own copy of the working directory, so file changes in one session do not affect another.

- **Create**: Create a new worktree for an isolated session
- **Apply**: Merge worktree changes back into the main working directory
- **Remove**: Clean up a worktree when the session is done

---

### Persistence Format

Grok stores the conversation as newline-delimited JSON (JSONL). Each line in `updates.jsonl` is a self-contained ACP session update event. This format supports:

- Incremental writes (append-only during a session)
- Efficient streaming reads (for session restore)
- Easy debugging (each line is valid JSON)

### Session Metadata

`summary.json` records, among other fields:

- `info` -- the session ID and working directory
- `session_summary` and `generated_title` -- the session summary and its model-generated title
- `created_at` and `updated_at` -- creation and last-update timestamps
- `num_messages` and `num_chat_messages` -- update and chat-message counts
- `current_model_id` -- the model in use
- `parent_session_id` -- the source session for a fork or restore
- `agent_name` -- the agent definition active when the session was last saved

### Disk Usage

---

- Use `/new` to start fresh when your current context is no longer relevant.
- Use `/compact` proactively in long sessions to keep the context window effective.
- Use `/rewind` to undo mistakes; it restores actual file snapshots instead of relying on the agent to reconstruct earlier state.

===== E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）\docs\specs\GOAL-ops-knowledge-ab.txt =====
你是执行者，这份文档是你唯一的任务来源；中途没人可问，拿不准写进 BLOCKED.md 跳过继续，最后随交付提交。
断了/新会话：先读 PROGRESS.md 接着做，别重做；每完成一项立刻更新。
这活为什么干：异常处置只有自由文本 note，经验不可复用；干完后运营打开任务能同时看到「历史统计」和「已发布剧本」，闭环时动作+效果可结构化沉淀。
让步顺序：结构化闭环正确 > 双轨效果可查询 > 三平台骨架可演示 > UI 好看。
死规矩=「只允许/不许」违反即失败；「建议」可换路并记 PROGRESS.md。

## 我替领导拍的板
1. 可指导=A+B（已确认）：任务详情同时返回历史Top统计 + 仅published剧本；无剧本时统计仍可用。
2. 效果=标签+指标双轨：resolve 必填 effect_code；metric_effect 可空，有 fact 时异步回填，无 fact 不失败。
3. 范围=三平台各1类：amazon/link_wow_units_drop、tiktok/low_roi、temu/listing_off。
4. 知识来源=预置码表+任务回写聚合；不做 LLM、不挖旧 free-text。

1. 可指导=A+B（猜的已确认）：任务详情同时返回历史Top统计 + 仅published剧本；无剧本时统计仍可用。
2. 效果=标签+指标双轨：resolve 必填 effect_code；metric_effect 可空，有 fact 时异步回填，无 fact 不失败。
3. 范围=三平台各1类：amazon/link_wow_units_drop、tiktok/low_roi、temu/listing_off。
4. 知识来源=预置码表+任务回写聚合；不做 LLM、不挖旧 free-text。
5. 可指导不含自动改价/预算（G3）；推荐只读+人选用。
6. 交付=一份垂直切片（API+迁移+最小Web+测试）。
7. pytest 若未装：允许在 backend 虚拟环境 pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx，记 PROGRESS；不许改 requirements 锁死版本除非已有文件追加一行。

## 界限
只允许改/新建：
- backend/migrations/004_ops_knowledge.sql（或下一可用序号）
- backend/app/domain/（task_engine 及相关新模块 kb_*.py）
- backend/app/api/（tasks.py 扩展 + 新 kb 路由并挂 main.py）
- backend/app/scripts/（种子扩展，可选）
- backend/tests/（新建测试）
- web/src/（App.vue / api.js 最小展示）
- docs/openapi-v1.yaml（与实现同步）
- 仓库根 PROGRESS.md、BLOCKED.md
- backend/requirements.txt 仅可追加 pytest/pytest-asyncio（若测需要）
其余路径只读。不许改 CI/密钥/docker 生产凭据/001–003 已落地 SQL 语义（可新 migration 扩展列）。
判卷：本任务书与测试文件可增不可删断言放宽。最诱人顺手活（飞书同步字段、环比跑批修复、导航大改）→ BLOCKED.md。

## 现状与任务0（2026-07-29 实测）
- task_progress 仅 note 自由文本；无 action_code/effect/知识表（001_init.sql）。
- AMZ 规则种子4条在 002；演示种子含三平台多类型（seed_demo_tasks.py）。
- backend/tests 目录空；默认 python 无 pytest/fastapi；存在 backend/.venv（True）。
- API：POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/progress|resolve 仅 note（tasks.py）。
任务0：在 backend/.venv 跑 python -c "import fastapi; print(fastapi.__version__)"；失败则用该 venv pip 装 requirements 再核。写 PROGRESS 开工回执≤10行（目标/顺序/最大风险）再动工。对不上现状就停，证据置顶 BLOCKED.md。

## 任务1 数据模型
新增：ops_action_dict(code,name,platform可空,enabled)；ops_effect_dict(code,name,enabled)；task_progress 增 action_code/effect_code 可空+兼容旧 note；task 可冗余 last_action_code/last_effect_code；kb_playbook(id,platform,anomaly_type,title,body,action_codes[],status draft|published|rejected,evidence jsonb,created_at…)；可选 task_effect_metric(task_id, window_days, metric, before, after, delta_ratio, computed_at) 或 JSON 挂 task。
种子：≥3 action（每平台至少1）、≥4 effect（recovered/partial/no_effect/false_positive）、3 条骨架 anomaly 各 1 条 published 剧本（可短）。
验收：psql 或 SQLAlchemy 查表存在；三字典/剧本 count≥上述。

## 任务2 写路径
扩展 progress：可选 action_code+note；resolve：effect_code 对三骨架类型必填（其它类型可仅 note 兼容）；非法 code→400。
指标回填：提供函数/POST 内部或 /api/v1/kb/metric-backfill 对 amazon+link_wow_units_drop 在 fact_amz_link_daily 有数据时写入 metric；无数据返回 skipped 不 500。
验收：venv 下 pytest -q 覆盖 合法闭环 / 缺 effect_code 400 / 未知 action 400；测试数≥4 且 skipped=0。

## 任务3 读路径 A+B
GET /api/v1/kb/guidance?platform=&anomaly_type= 返回：
- history: 按 action_code 聚合次数与 effect 分布（可空数组）
- playbooks: 仅 status=published
POST /api/v1/kb/playbooks/generate-draft 从 history 生成 draft（无人审不进 playbooks 列表的 published）；POST .../publish 变 published。
验收：先 seed 结构化闭环≥2 → guidance.history 非空；draft 不出现在 guidance.playbooks；publish 后出现。反向：把 published 改 draft 后再 GET，playbooks 不得含该条（测后还原）。

## 任务4 最小 Web
任务抽屉/详情：调 guidance 展示两块标题「历史参考」「已发布剧本」；闭环表单可选 action + 必选 effect（骨架类型）。不求美观。
验收：手测或组件不报错即可；API 契约测试不过则本任务不算完成。

## 规矩
防作弊：禁止 pytest skip/xfail 滥用、放宽断言、mock 掉 DB 却声称集成通过、删测、|| true；测试只许≥开工基线（基线0，交付≥4）。
不新增鉴权体系；沿用 get_current_user。同一验收连败3次换项；比开工差则回滚报告。
进度：PROGRESS.md；卡死：BLOCKED.md。

## 完成条件
硬指标1：对三骨架类型各至少1次「resolve 带 action+effect」后，guidance 返回 history，且至少1条 published playbook 可被 GET 到。
硬指标2：白名单外 git diff 为空（或仅 PROGRESS/BLOCKED）；无自动执行平台操作代码。
每条验收在对话贴真实命令输出（含反向验证红→绿）。BLOCKED.md 必交（无则写「无」）。
止损：有效工时盒约1个工作日或同项失败3次→停，如实汇报。

1	# TK 英区店铺广告数据自动化监测
2	
3	紫鸟浏览器 **卖家自研插件**（Chrome MV3 扩展）：在已登录的 TikTok 店铺环境中抓取广告核心字段，并写入飞书多维表格。
4	
5	## 抓取字段
6	
7	| 字段 | 说明 |
8	|------|------|
9	| 广告系列名称 | Campaign / 品名 |
10	| 广告花费 | Spend / Cost（**美金 USD**，与广告后台一致） |
11	| 销量 | Orders / Units |
12	| ROI | ROI / ROAS |
13	| 总收入 | GMV / Revenue / 销售额（**美金 USD**） |
14	
15	另附：业务日期、店铺、抓取时间、数据源 URL、状态。
16	
17	## 目录
18	
19	```
20	extension/          # 插件源码（加载已解压 / 打包上传）
21	docs/               # 飞书建表、安装上架、运维排障
22	scripts/            # package-zip.ps1
23	```
24	
25	## 快速开始
26	
27	### 1. 飞书
28	
29	按 [docs/飞书表格建表说明.md](docs/飞书表格建表说明.md) 建表并创建自建应用。
30	
31	### 2. 紫鸟调试加载
32	
33	1. 紫鸟中打开店铺窗口 → `chrome://extensions/` → 开发者模式  
34	2. 「加载已解压的扩展程序」→ 选择 `extension` 目录  
35	3. 扩展 **设置** 中填写飞书 App ID / Secret / app_token / table_id  
36	4. 打开广告数据列表 → Popup **立即抓取**（建议先勾选干跑）
37	
38	详见 [docs/安装与上架指南.md](docs/安装与上架指南.md)。
39	
40	### 3. 打包上架
41	
42	```powershell
43	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\package-zip.ps1
44	```
45	
46	将 `dist/tk-ad-scraper-v*.zip` 上传至紫鸟开放平台「卖家自研插件」，并在应用管理中分配给店铺账号。
47	
48	## 功能概览
49	
50	- 手动一键抓取 + 结果预览  
51	- DOM 表头语义匹配（中英）+ 页面 fetch/XHR 报表兜底  
52	- 飞书 `tenant_access_token` + 多维表批量写入（分批 500、失败重试）  
53	- 每日定时（`chrome.alarms`，默认可设 07:30）  
54	- 本地日志与 JSON 导出  
55	
56	## 启动器（推荐）
57	
58	双击其一即可（风格对齐海外仓 `美化启动器.bat`）：
59	
60	| 文件 | 说明 |
61	|------|------|
62	| **`美化启动器.bat`** | 打开图形界面 `gui.py`（按钮：预览/干跑/写飞书/装任务/日志） |
63	| **`启动器.bat`** | 纯控制台菜单，不依赖 Python GUI |
64	| **`安装环境.bat`** | 一键安装 Node.js LTS + ziniao-cli（可选填 API Key） |
65	
66	运营使用说明见 **[docs/美化启动器使用手册.md](docs/美化启动器使用手册.md)**（预览→干跑→写飞书、日报查看、17:20 任务、常见问题）。
67	
68	需本机已安装 Python 3（图形启动器）；控制台菜单只需 PowerShell。
69	
70	### 环境依赖（多店脚本）
71	
72	| 依赖 | 安装方式 |
73	|------|----------|
74	| **Node.js LTS** | `安装环境.bat` 或 `scripts\install-deps.ps1`（winget） |
75	| **ziniao-cli** | 同上（`npm i -g @ziniao-open/cli`） |
76	| **紫鸟桌面客户端** | 需自行安装并登录（脚本无法静默安装桌面端） |
77	| **飞书配置** | `config\stores.config.json` |
78	
79	```powershell
80	# 一键安装 + 自检（默认国内镜像：npmmirror Node 安装包 + npm registry）
81	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1
82	
83	# 顺带写入紫鸟 API Key（成员账号）
84	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1 -ApiKey "你的密钥"
85	
86	# 只用官方源（nodejs.org / registry.npmjs.org）
87	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1 -UseOfficialMirror
88	
89	# 只做环境自检
90	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1 -DoctorOnly
91	```
92	
93	自动安装失败时，按 **[docs/手动安装环境.md](docs/手动安装环境.md)** 逐步装 Node / ziniao-cli / 紫鸟客户端。
94	
95	## 多店铺自动串行（店名会变也不怕）
96	
97	店铺列表**每次运行时从紫鸟动态拉取**，不写死数量：
98	
99	```powershell
100	# 1. 复制并编辑配置（筛选规则 + 飞书 + 店名映射）
101	copy config\stores.config.example.json config\stores.config.json
102	
103	# 2. 只看会抓哪些店
104	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-multi-store.ps1 -ListOnly
105	
106	# 3. 干跑（默认 config 里 dryRun=true）
107	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-multi-store.ps1
108	
109	# 4. 正式写入飞书
110	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-multi-store.ps1 -DryRun false
111	```
112

# TK 英区店铺广告数据自动化监测

紫鸟浏览器 **卖家自研插件**（Chrome MV3 扩展）：在已登录的 TikTok 店铺环境中抓取广告核心字段，并写入飞书多维表格。

## 抓取字段

| 字段 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 广告系列名称 | Campaign / 品名 |
| 广告花费 | Spend / Cost（**美金 USD**，与广告后台一致） |
| 销量 | Orders / Units |
| ROI | ROI / ROAS |
| 总收入 | GMV / Revenue / 销售额（**美金 USD**） |

另附：业务日期、店铺、抓取时间、数据源 URL、状态。

## 目录

```
extension/          # 插件源码（加载已解压 / 打包上传）
docs/               # 飞书建表、安装上架、运维排障
scripts/            # package-zip.ps1
```

## 快速开始

### 1. 飞书

按 [docs/飞书表格建表说明.md](docs/飞书表格建表说明.md) 建表并创建自建应用。

### 2. 紫鸟调试加载

1. 紫鸟中打开店铺窗口 → `chrome://extensions/` → 开发者模式  
2. 「加载已解压的扩展程序」→ 选择 `extension` 目录  
3. 扩展 **设置** 中填写飞书 App ID / Secret / app_token / table_id  
4. 打开广告数据列表 → Popup **立即抓取**（建议先勾选干跑）

详见 [docs/安装与上架指南.md](docs/安装与上架指南.md)。

### 3. 打包上架

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\package-zip.ps1
```

将 `dist/tk-ad-scraper-v*.zip` 上传至紫鸟开放平台「卖家自研插件」，并在应用管理中分配给店铺账号。

## 功能概览

- 手动一键抓取 + 结果预览  
- DOM 表头语义匹配（中英）+ 页面 fetch/XHR 报表兜底  
- 飞书 `tenant_access_token` + 多维表批量写入（分批 500、失败重试）  
- 每日定时（`chrome.alarms`，默认可设 07:30）  
- 本地日志与 JSON 导出  

## 启动器（推荐）

双击其一即可（风格对齐海外仓 `美化启动器.bat`）：

| 文件 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **`美化启动器.bat`** | 打开图形界面 `gui.py`（按钮：预览/干跑/写飞书/装任务/日志） |
| **`启动器.bat`** | 纯控制台菜单，不依赖 Python GUI |
| **`安装环境.bat`** | 一键安装 Node.js LTS + ziniao-cli（可选填 API Key） |

运营使用说明见 **[docs/美化启动器使用手册.md](docs/美化启动器使用手册.md)**（预览→干跑→写飞书、日报查看、17:20 任务、常见问题）。

需本机已安装 Python 3（图形启动器）；控制台菜单只需 PowerShell。

### 环境依赖（多店脚本）

| 依赖 | 安装方式 |
|------|----------|
| **Node.js LTS** | `安装环境.bat` 或 `scripts\install-deps.ps1`（winget） |
| **ziniao-cli** | 同上（`npm i -g @ziniao-open/cli`） |
| **紫鸟桌面客户端** | 需自行安装并登录（脚本无法静默安装桌面端） |
| **飞书配置** | `config\stores.config.json` |

```powershell
# 一键安装 + 自检（默认国内镜像：npmmirror Node 安装包 + npm registry）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1

# 顺带写入紫鸟 API Key（成员账号）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1 -ApiKey "你的密钥"

# 只用官方源（nodejs.org / registry.npmjs.org）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1 -UseOfficialMirror

# 只做环境自检
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-deps.ps1 -DoctorOnly
```

自动安装失败时，按 **[docs/手动安装环境.md](docs/手动安装环境.md)** 逐步装 Node / ziniao-cli / 紫鸟客户端。

## 多店铺自动串行（店名会变也不怕）

店铺列表**每次运行时从紫鸟动态拉取**，不写死数量：

```powershell
# 1. 复制并编辑配置（筛选规则 + 飞书 + 店名映射）
copy config\stores.config.example.json config\stores.config.json

# 2. 只看会抓哪些店
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-multi-store.ps1 -ListOnly

# 3. 干跑（默认 config 里 dryRun=true）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-multi-store.ps1

# 4. 正式写入飞书
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-multi-store.ps1 -DryRun false
```

抓取结束后会自动生成 **日报总结分析**（总览、分店 KPI、亮点、低 ROI 风险、TOP 系列），统一放在项目根目录 **`日报/`**（`日报-日期.md` / `简报-日期.txt` / `最新日报.md`），说明见 [docs/日报分析说明.md](docs/日报分析说明.md)。抓取调试日志仍在 `logs/`。

筛选示例见 `config/stores.config.example.json`：

- `platformContains: ["TikTok"]` — 只要 TikTok 相关  
- `requireIp: true` — 跳过未绑定设备（如你列表里的 TT-L）  
- `excludeStoreIds` / `includeStoreIds` — 精确排除或只跑指定店  
- `storeNameMap` — 紫鸟账号名 → 飞书「店铺」列展示名（如 `Tiktok_Shop2` → `Deal to deal`）

新增店铺：只要在紫鸟里建好并绑定设备，且命中筛选规则，**下次运行自动纳入**，无需改代码。

## 重要限制

- 插件一键抓取：依赖当前已打开的店铺窗口。  
- 多店串行：依赖本机 `ziniao-cli` + 紫鸟客户端在线，**一店一开一关**，勿并行狂开。  
- 定时任务（扩展 alarms）在浏览器退出后不可靠；生产建议 Windows 任务计划调用 `run-multi-store.ps1`。  
- TikTok 后台改版可能导致选择器失效，需按 [docs/运维与排障.md](docs/运维与排障.md) 更新别名。

## 需求来源

- `海外店铺数据抓取与自动化需求分析.docx`  
- `TK广告数据抓取项目梳理.xmind`  
- 开放平台：[卖家自研插件](https://open.ziniao.com/docSupport?docId=101)  

## 许可与范围

仅供企业内部使用（卖家自研插件）。勿将飞书密钥写入仓库。

# TK 广告采集 · 中心化改造方案

> 目标：现有「紫鸟抓取 → 直写飞书」改为「紫鸟抓取 → **清泉中心** → 飞书」  
> 原则：**旁路上报、开关切换、不打断 17:20 生产任务**

源项目：`E:\project\海外TK店铺广告投流数据自动化监测`

---

## 1. 现状链路

```
计划任务 17:20
  → run-multi-store.ps1
      → ziniao store open / page exec (scrape-ads-page.js)
      → 直接 Feishu batch_create
      → daily-analysis.ps1 → 本地日报
```

并行：Chrome 扩展 Popup / alarms → service-worker → feishu/bitable.js

**问题：** 飞书为事实源、仅 append 易重复、无任务引擎、数据不进企业库。

---

## 2. 目标链路

```
计划任务 17:20
  → run-multi-store.ps1
      → ziniao 抓取（不变）
      → [新] POST 清泉 /api/v1/ingest/tiktok_ads
      → [开关] 可选仍直写飞书（过渡）
      → daily-analysis 可改为读中心 API（Phase1 后）

中心
  → 幂等落 fact_ads_campaign_daily
  → Outbox → 飞书 Sync（create/update，按映射表）
  → 规则（低 ROI 等）→ anomaly/task（可二期）
```

扩展路径同步：service-worker 写飞书前先 report 中心。

---

## 3. 改造阶段

### Stage A — 旁路上报（推荐先做，零停机）

| 项 | 做法 |
|----|------|
| 配置 | `stores.config.json` 增加 `qingquan` 节点 |
| PS | 抓取成功后调用 `Report-ToQingquan`；失败打日志 **不阻断** 原飞书写入 |
| 扩展 | `DEFAULT_CONFIG` 增加中心 URL + API Key；先 report 再 feishu |
| 中心 | Phase0 Ingest 已就绪 |
| 飞书 | 仍由 TK 脚本直写（双写） |

**验收：** 中心库有当日广告行；飞书与现网一致；中心挂掉不影响飞书。

### Stage B — 中心同步飞书

| 项 | 做法 |
|----|------|
| 中心 | 配置 TK 多维表 app_token/table_id；Sync Worker 开启 |
| 映射 | 用 `biz_date+storeId+campaign` 做业务键生成稳定 local_id/hash |
| 开关 | `feishu.writeMode = "center"` 时 PS/扩展 **停止直写** |
| 去重 | 首次切流前跑「重建同步」作业，按业务键绑定已有 record_id（或清空测试表） |

**验收：** 同日重跑不产生重复飞书行；改 spend 后飞书数值更新。

### Stage C — 收尾

- 日报改为中心 API 聚合（或 SQL）生成  
- 低 ROI / 零销花费 → 自动 task  
- 扩展 alarms 降级为开发调试，生产只保留 schtasks  
- 密钥仅留在中心与采集配置，去除 dist with-secrets 包

---

## 4. 配置变更

### 4.1 `config/stores.config.json` 增加

```json
{
  "qingquan": {
    "enabled": true,
    "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8000",
    "apiKey": "dev-ingest-key",
    "source": "tiktok_ads",
    "failOpen": true,
    "timeoutSec": 30
  },
  "feishu": {
    "writeMode": "direct",
    "comment": "direct | center | dual"
  }
}
```

"""采集上报：幂等写入 ingest_raw，并按 source 分发到事实表。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import require_ingest_key

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/ingest", tags=["ingest"])


class Evidence(BaseModel):
    screenshot_url: str | None = None
    source_url: str | None = None
    raw_ref: str | None = None


class IngestEnvelope(BaseModel):
    platform: str | None = None
    shop_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="外部店铺 ID")
    shop_name: str | None = None
    biz_date: date | None = None
    collected_at: datetime | None = None
    idempotency_key: str
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    evidence: Evidence | None = None


class IngestBatch(BaseModel):
    items: list[IngestEnvelope] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


async def _resolve_shop_uuid(db: AsyncSession, platform: str | None, external_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not external_id:
        return None
    if platform:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text FROM shop
                    WHERE external_shop_id = :eid AND platform = :platform
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"eid": external_id, "platform": platform},
            )
        ).first()
        if row:
            return row[0]
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text("SELECT id::text FROM shop WHERE external_shop_id = :eid LIMIT 1"),
            {"eid": external_id},
        )
    ).first()
    return row[0] if row else None


async def _process_tiktok_ads(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    ingest_id: str,
    env: IngestEnvelope,
    shop_uuid: str | None,
) -> None:
    p = env.payload
    campaign = str(p.get("campaign_name") or p.get("campaign") or "").strip()
    if not campaign or not env.biz_date or not env.shop_id:
        raise ValueError("tiktok_ads 需要 shop_id, biz_date, payload.campaign_name")

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO fact_ads_campaign_daily (
                id, shop_id, shop_external_id, shop_name, biz_date, campaign_name,
                spend, orders, roi, revenue, currency, row_status, source_url,
                plan_status, delivery_status, daily_budget, target_roi, net_cost, avg_order_cost,
                collected_at, ingest_id, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :shop_id, :shop_external_id, :shop_name, :biz_date, :campaign_name,
                :spend, :orders, :roi, :revenue, :currency, :row_status, :source_url,
                :plan_status, :delivery_status, :daily_budget, :target_roi, :net_cost, :avg_order_cost,
                :collected_at, :ingest_id, now(), now()
            )
            ON CONFLICT (shop_external_id, campaign_name, biz_date) DO UPDATE SET
                spend = EXCLUDED.spend,
                orders = EXCLUDED.orders,
                roi = EXCLUDED.roi,
                revenue = EXCLUDED.revenue,
                currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
                row_status = EXCLUDED.row_status,
                source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
                plan_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.plan_status, fact_ads_campaign_daily.plan_status),
                delivery_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.delivery_status, fact_ads_campaign_daily.delivery_status),
                daily_budget = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.daily_budget, fact_ads_campaign_daily.daily_budget),
                target_roi = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.target_roi, fact_ads_campaign_daily.target_roi),
                net_cost = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.net_cost, fact_ads_campaign_daily.net_cost),
                avg_order_cost = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avg_order_cost, fact_ads_campaign_daily.avg_order_cost),
                collected_at = EXCLUDED.collected_at,
                ingest_id = EXCLUDED.ingest_id,
                shop_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.shop_id, fact_ads_campaign_daily.shop_id),
                shop_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.shop_name, fact_ads_campaign_daily.shop_name),
                updated_at = now()
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "shop_id": shop_uuid,
            "shop_external_id": env.shop_id,
            "shop_name": env.shop_name,
            "biz_date": env.biz_date,
            "campaign_name": campaign,
            "spend": float(p.get("spend") or 0),
            "orders": float(p.get("orders") or 0),
            "roi": float(p["roi"]) if p.get("roi") is not None else None,
            "revenue": float(p.get("revenue") or 0),
            "currency": p.get("currency") or "GBP",
            "row_status": p.get("row_status") or "success",
            "source_url": (env.evidence.source_url if env.evidence else None) or p.get("source_url"),
            "plan_status": (str(p.get("plan_status") or p.get("planStatus") or "").strip() or None),
            "delivery_status": (
                str(p.get("delivery_status") or p.get("deliveryStatus") or "").strip() or None
            ),
            "daily_budget": _opt_float(p.get("daily_budget") if p.get("daily_budget") is not None else p.get("dailyBudget")),
            "target_roi": _opt_float(p.get("target_roi") if p.get("target_roi") is not None else p.get("targetRoi")),
            "net_cost": _opt_float(p.get("net_cost") if p.get("net_cost") is not None else p.get("netCost")),
            "avg_order_cost": _opt_float(
                p.get("avg_order_cost") if p.get("avg_order_cost") is not None else p.get("avgOrderCost")
            ),
            "collected_at": env.collected_at,
            "ingest_id": ingest_id,
        },
    )


def _opt_float(v: Any) -> float | None:
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    return float(v)


async def _process_amz_link_daily(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    ingest_id: str,
    env: IngestEnvelope,
    shop_uuid: str | None,
) -> None:
    """Amazon 链接日指标 → fact_amz_link_daily（只写事实，不建任务）。"""
    p = env.payload or {}
    asin = str(p.get("asin") or "").strip() or None
    seller_sku = str(p.get("seller_sku") or p.get("sku") or "").strip() or None
    if not env.biz_date or not env.shop_id:
        raise ValueError("amz_link_daily 需要 shop_id, biz_date")
    if not asin and not seller_sku:
        raise ValueError("amz_link_daily 需要 payload.asin 或 payload.seller_sku")

    known = {
        "asin",
        "seller_sku",
        "sku",
        "parent_asin",
        "title",
        "units",
        "sales_amount",
        "currency",
        "sessions",
        "conversion_rate",
        "fba_fulfillable",
        "source_url",
    }
    extra = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k not in known}

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO fact_amz_link_daily (
                id, shop_id, shop_external_id, biz_date, asin, seller_sku, parent_asin,
                title, units, sales_amount, currency, sessions, conversion_rate,
                fba_fulfillable, raw_extra, ingest_id, collected_at, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :shop_id, :shop_external_id, :biz_date, :asin, :seller_sku, :parent_asin,
                :title, :units, :sales_amount, :currency, :sessions, :conversion_rate,
                :fba_fulfillable, CAST(:raw_extra AS jsonb), :ingest_id, :collected_at, now(), now()
            )
            ON CONFLICT (shop_external_id, biz_date, biz_key) DO UPDATE SET
                shop_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.shop_id, fact_amz_link_daily.shop_id),
                asin = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.asin, fact_amz_link_daily.asin),
                seller_sku = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.seller_sku, fact_amz_link_daily.seller_sku),
                parent_asin = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.parent_asin, fact_amz_link_daily.parent_asin),
                title = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.title, fact_amz_link_daily.title),
                units = EXCLUDED.units,
                sales_amount = EXCLUDED.sales_amount,
                currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
                sessions = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sessions, fact_amz_link_daily.sessions),
                conversion_rate = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.conversion_rate, fact_amz_link_daily.conversion_rate),
                fba_fulfillable = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fba_fulfillable, fact_amz_link_daily.fba_fulfillable),
                raw_extra = EXCLUDED.raw_extra,
                ingest_id = EXCLUDED.ingest_id,
                collected_at = EXCLUDED.collected_at,
                updated_at = now()
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "shop_id": shop_uuid,
            "shop_external_id": env.shop_id,
            "biz_date": env.biz_date,
            "asin": asin,
            "seller_sku": seller_sku,
            "parent_asin": str(p.get("parent_asin") or "").strip() or None,
            "title": str(p.get("title") or "").strip() or None,
            "units": float(p.get("units") or 0),
            "sales_amount": float(p.get("sales_amount") or 0),
            "currency": p.get("currency") or "GBP",
            "sessions": _opt_float(p.get("sessions")),
            "conversion_rate": _opt_float(p.get("conversion_rate")),
            "fba_fulfillable": _opt_float(p.get("fba_fulfillable")),
            "raw_extra": json.dumps(extra, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
            "ingest_id": ingest_id,
            "collected_at": env.collected_at,
        },
    )


def _default_platform(source: str, env_platform: str | None) -> str | None:
    if env_platform:
        return env_platform
    if source.startswith("tiktok"):
        return "tiktok"
    if source in ("amz_link_daily", "sellfox_link_daily", "amazon_link_daily"):
        return "amazon"
    if source.startswith("temu"):
        return "temu"
    return None


async def _ingest_one(
    db: AsyncSession,
    source: str,
    env: IngestEnvelope,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    platform = _default_platform(source, env.platform)
    shop_uuid = await _resolve_shop_uuid(db, platform, env.shop_id)
    ingest_id = str(uuid4())
    evidence = (env.evidence.model_dump() if env.evidence else {}) or {}

    try:
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO ingest_raw (
                    id, source, platform, shop_external_id, shop_id, biz_date,
                    idempotency_key, payload, evidence, collected_at, process_status
                ) VALUES (
                    :id, :source, :platform, :shop_external_id, :shop_id, :biz_date,
                    :idempotency_key, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), CAST(:evidence AS jsonb),
                    :collected_at, 'accepted'
                )
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": ingest_id,
                "source": source,
                "platform": platform,
                "shop_external_id": env.shop_id,
                "shop_id": shop_uuid,
                "biz_date": env.biz_date,
                "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
                "payload": json.dumps(env.payload, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
                "evidence": json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False),
                "collected_at": env.collected_at,
            },
        )
    except IntegrityError:
        await db.rollback()
        existing = (
            await db.execute(
                text("SELECT id::text FROM ingest_raw WHERE idempotency_key = :k"),
                {"k": env.idempotency_key},
            )
        ).first()
        return {
            "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
            "id": existing[0] if existing else None,
            "status": "duplicated",
            "error": None,
        }

    try:
        if source == "tiktok_ads":
            await _process_tiktok_ads(db, ingest_id=ingest_id, env=env, shop_uuid=shop_uuid)
        elif source in ("amz_link_daily", "sellfox_link_daily", "amazon_link_daily"):
            await _process_amz_link_daily(db, ingest_id=ingest_id, env=env, shop_uuid=shop_uuid)
        # 其它 source 仅保留原始
        await db.execute(
            text("UPDATE ingest_raw SET process_status = 'processed' WHERE id = :id"),
            {"id": ingest_id},
        )
        await db.commit()
        return {
            "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
            "id": ingest_id,
            "status": "created",
            "error": None,
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        # 重新标记失败：原事务已回滚，补写失败状态可能丢 id，简化返回 failed
        return {
            "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
            "id": ingest_id,
            "status": "failed",
            "error": str(exc),
        }


@router.post("/{source}")
async def ingest(
    source: str,
    body: dict[str, Any],
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(require_ingest_key),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if "items" in body:
        batch = IngestBatch.model_validate(body)
        items = batch.items
    else:
        items = [IngestEnvelope.model_validate(body)]

    results = []
    for env in items:
        results.append(await _ingest_one(db, source, env))

    return {
        "accepted": sum(1 for r in results if r["status"] == "created"),
        "duplicated": sum(1 for r in results if r["status"] == "duplicated"),
        "failed": sum(1 for r in results if r["status"] == "failed"),
        "results": results,
    }

I found the key issue! The production config points to `https://qingquan.jmzlai.com` with `apiKey` starting with `dev-` (length 14, likely `dev-ingest-key`). The error was:
I see the core problem now — the production endpoint is rejecting the request because the body is null, even though auth seems to be passing. That points to either a client-side serialization issue or a mismatch in how the request is being built.

Let me break this down:

1. **Body validation timing**: FastAPI does validate the body *before* most dependencies in recent versions, so if the body ends up as null, it fails early.

2. **PowerShell serialization gotcha**: The classic `$items += [ordered]@{...}` pattern when `$items` starts as `@()` can silently turn `$items` into a single hasht ible after the first item. Then `@($Items)` in the payload construction might be working around it, but the JSON output could still be malformed.

3. **HttpWebRequest specifics**: The code looks solid, but if the JSON string is empty or the encoding is off, the body length becomes 0.

file.content:
# 清泉跨境 · 生产 Compose（仅回环暴露）
# 用法（在 deploy/ 目录）:
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env up -d --build

name: qingquan

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ../backend/migrations/001_init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/001_init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  api:
    build:
      context: ../backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    env_file:
      - ../.env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      APP_ENV: prod
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    command: >
      uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 1
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  pgdata:

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# 本机执行：同步代码到 qingquan-sg 并拉起生产栈
3	set -euo pipefail
4	
5	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
6	HOST="${QINGQUAN_HOST:-qingquan-sg}"
7	REMOTE_DIR=/opt/qingquan
8	SECRETS="${ROOT}/secrets/ops.env"
9	
10	if [[ -f "$SECRETS" ]]; then
11	  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
12	  set -a; source "$SECRETS"; set +a
13	fi
14	
15	echo "==> rsync → ${HOST}:${REMOTE_DIR}"
16	ssh "$HOST" "sudo mkdir -p ${REMOTE_DIR} && sudo chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu ${REMOTE_DIR}"
17	rsync -az --delete \
18	  --exclude '.git' \
19	  --exclude 'node_modules' \
20	  --exclude '.venv' \
21	  --exclude 'venv' \
22	  --exclude '__pycache__' \
23	  --exclude 'secrets/' \
24	  --exclude '.env' \
25	  --exclude 'ai-dev-sop-v2.3.1' \
26	  --exclude '*.xmind' \
27	  --exclude '*.png' \
28	  --exclude '*.jpg' \
29	  --exclude '归档' \
30	  "${ROOT}/" "${HOST}:${REMOTE_DIR}/"
31	
32	if [[ -f "$SECRETS" ]]; then
33	  echo "==> upload .env (from secrets/ops.env filtered)"
34	  # 只上传应用相关变量
35	  ssh "$HOST" "cat > ${REMOTE_DIR}/.env" <<EOF
36	APP_ENV=prod
37	APP_SECRET_KEY=${APP_SECRET_KEY}
38	APP_NAME=${APP_NAME:-清泉跨境系统}
39	API_PORT=8000
40	POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}
41	POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
42	POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
43	DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
44	REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
45	JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES=${JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES:-1440}
46	INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY=${INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY}
47	ADMIN_USERNAME=${ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}
48	ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
49	DEFAULT_TASK_DUE_DAYS=${DEFAULT_TASK_DUE_DAYS:-3}
50	TZ=Asia/Shanghai
51	EOF
52	  ssh "$HOST" "chmod 600 ${REMOTE_DIR}/.env"
53	fi
54	
55	echo "==> remote build web + compose up"
56	ssh "$HOST" bash -s <<'REMOTE'
57	set -euo pipefail
58	cd /opt/qingquan
59	
60	# Node for web build (install if missing)
61	if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
62	  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | sudo -E bash -
63	  sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
64	fi
65	
66	cd web
67	npm ci || npm install
68	npm run build
69	cd ..
70	
71	cd deploy
72	docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env up -d --build
73	
74	# wait health
75	for i in $(seq 1 30); do
76	  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then
77	    echo "API healthy"
78	    break
79	  fi
80	  sleep 2
81	done
82	curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
83	
84	# seed admin (idempotent-ish)
85	docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env exec -T api \
86	  python -m app.scripts.seed || true
87

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 本机执行：同步代码到 qingquan-sg 并拉起生产栈
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
HOST="${QINGQUAN_HOST:-qingquan-sg}"
REMOTE_DIR=/opt/qingquan
SECRETS="${ROOT}/secrets/ops.env"

if [[ -f "$SECRETS" ]]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  set -a; source "$SECRETS"; set +a
fi

echo "==> rsync → ${HOST}:${REMOTE_DIR}"
ssh "$HOST" "sudo mkdir -p ${REMOTE_DIR} && sudo chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu ${REMOTE_DIR}"
rsync -az --delete \
  --exclude '.git' \
  --exclude 'node_modules' \
  --exclude '.venv' \
  --exclude 'venv' \
  --exclude '__pycache__' \
  --exclude 'secrets/' \
  --exclude '.env' \
  --exclude 'ai-dev-sop-v2.3.1' \
  --exclude '*.xmind' \
  --exclude '*.png' \
  --exclude '*.jpg' \
  --exclude '归档' \
  "${ROOT}/" "${HOST}:${REMOTE_DIR}/"

if [[ -f "$SECRETS" ]]; then
  echo "==> upload .env (from secrets/ops.env filtered)"
  # 只上传应用相关变量
  ssh "$HOST" "cat > ${REMOTE_DIR}/.env" <<EOF
APP_ENV=prod
APP_SECRET_KEY=${APP_SECRET_KEY}
APP_NAME=${APP_NAME:-清泉跨境系统}
API_PORT=8000
POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES=${JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES:-1440}
INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY=${INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY}
ADMIN_USERNAME=${ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}
ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
DEFAULT_TASK_DUE_DAYS=${DEFAULT_TASK_DUE_DAYS:-3}
TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EOF
  ssh "$HOST" "chmod 600 ${REMOTE_DIR}/.env"
fi

echo "==> remote build web + compose up"
ssh "$HOST" bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/qingquan

# Node for web build (install if missing)
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | sudo -E bash -
  sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
fi

cd web
npm ci || npm install
npm run build
cd ..

cd deploy
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env up -d --build

# wait health
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then
    echo "API healthy"
    break
  fi
  sleep 2
done
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health

# seed admin (idempotent-ish)
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env exec -T api \
  python -m app.scripts.seed || true

# nginx site
sudo mkdir -p /var/www/certbot
sudo cp /opt/qingquan/deploy/nginx-qingquan.jmzlai.com.conf \
  /etc/nginx/sites-available/qingquan.jmzlai.com
sudo ln -sfn /etc/nginx/sites-available/qingquan.jmzlai.com \
  /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/qingquan.jmzlai.com

# 若证书尚不存在，先用仅 HTTP 临时配置让 certbot 能签
if [[ ! -f /etc/letsencrypt/live/qingquan.jmzlai.com/fullchain.pem ]]; then
  sudo tee /etc/nginx/sites-available/qingquan.jmzlai.com >/dev/null <<'NGX'
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name qingquan.jmzlai.com;
    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/certbot; }
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
    location /health {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000/health;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
    location /docs { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs; }
    location /openapi.json { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000/openapi.json; }
    root /opt/qingquan/web/dist;
    index index.html;
    location / { try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html; }
}
NGX
fi

    avgOrderCost = $r.avgOrderCost

    planStatus = [string]$r.planStatus
    currency = "USD"
    sourceUrl = [string]$pay.url
    status = "success"
  }
}
$items = ConvertTo-QingquanIngestItems -Rows $rows -CollectedAt ((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+00:00')) -Currency 'USD'

if ($r.error) { Write-Host "err=$($r.error)" }

# 清泉跨境 · 生产 Compose（仅回环暴露）
# 用法（在 deploy/ 目录）:
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env up -d --build

name: qingquan

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ../backend/migrations/001_init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/001_init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  api:
    build:
      context: ../backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    env_file:
      - ../.env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      APP_ENV: prod
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    command: >
      uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 1
    restart: unless-stopped

String: function ConvertTo-QingquanIngestItems {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Rows,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string]$CollectedAt,
    [string]$Currency = 'USD'
  )
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Currency)) { $Currency = 'USD' }
  $items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
  foreach ($r in @($Rows)) {
    $campaign = [string]$r.campaign
    if (-not $campaign) { continue }
    $storeId = [string]$r.storeId
    $bizDate = [string]$r.date
    $spend = 0; if ($null -ne $r.spend) { $spend = [double]$r.spend }
    $orders = 0; if ($null -ne $r.orders) { $orders = [double]$r.orders }
    $roi = $null; if ($null -ne $r.roi) { $roi = [double]$r.roi }
    $revenue = 0; if ($null -ne $r.revenue) { $revenue = [double]$r.revenue }
    $dailyBudget = $null; if ($null -ne $r.dailyBudget -and "$($r.dailyBudget)" -ne '') { $dailyBudget = [double]$r.dailyBudget }
    $targetRoi = $null; if ($null -ne $r.targetRoi -and "$($r.targetRoi)" -ne '') { $targetRoi = [double]$r.targetRoi }
    $netCost = $null; if ($null -ne $r.netCost -and "$($r.netCost)" -ne '') { $netCost = [double]$r.netCost }
    $avgOrderCost = $null; if ($null -ne $r.avgOrderCost -and "$($r.avgOrderCost)" -ne '') { $avgOrderCost = [double]$r.avgOrderCost }
    $status = 'success'; if ($r.status) { $status = [string]$r.status }
    $planStatus = ''; if ($r.planStatus) { $planStatus = [string]$r.planStatus }
    $deliveryStatus = ''; if ($r.deliveryStatus) { $deliveryStatus = [string]$r.deliveryStatus }
    $sourceUrl = ''; if ($r.sourceUrl) { $sourceUrl = [string]$r.sourceUrl }
    $storeName = ''; if ($r.store) { $storeName = [string]$r.store }
    $rowCurrency = $Currency
    if ($r.currency) { $rowCurrency = [string]$r.currency }

    # 用 Hashtable（非 OrderedDictionary）避免 PS5.1 ConvertTo-Json 对有序字典序列化异常
    $payload = @{
      campaign_name   = $campaign
      spend           = $spend
      orders          = $orders
      roi             = $roi
      revenue         = $revenue
      daily_budget    = $dailyBudget
      target_roi      = $targetRoi
      net_cost        = $netCost
      avg_order_cost  = $avgOrderCost
      delivery_status = $deliveryStatus
      row_status      = $status
      plan_status     = $planStatus
      currency        = $rowCurrency
      source_url      = $sourceUrl
    }

    $items.Add(@{
      platform        = 'tiktok'
      shop_id         = $storeId
      shop_name       = $storeName
      biz_date        = $bizDate
      collected_at    = $CollectedAt
      idempotency_key = ("tiktok_ads:{0}:{1}:{2}" -f $storeId, $campaign, $bizDate)
      payload         = $payload

    }) | Out-Null
  }
